goal: Preserve generated RGB appearance while producing natural parallax under camera movement.

inputRoles.H: Primary saved Hi3D geometry and composed six-view color atlas.
inputRoles.F: Control with prior B geometry and the same original source RGB files.

F.manifestNote: Recovered Inspector storage manifest and original Factory manifest differ in metadata; native map bytes match the recorded hashes.

H.manifestNote: Recovered Inspector storage manifest and original Factory manifest differ in metadata; native map bytes match the recorded hashes.

fixed: Native color, normal, interval and range map bytes
Native ray intersection and fragment depth
Camera poses, viewport and RGB output curve within each comparison
variables: Camera weight sharpness and depth tolerance
Bounded normal confidence for RGB source selection, with no added lighting
evaluation: Independent front-view RGB reference sampled from the captured asset color atlas
Alpha and depth equivalence across color-selection variants
Matched head and body contact sheets at several angles
Actual animated orbit with view transitions
Depth-based reprojection on mutually visible surfaces; report coverage and limits
limits: Color reprojection consistency is not measured human anatomy or ground-truth view synthesis.
An orthographic front frame alone does not validate rotating views.
H aligned atlas and original F source RGB are distinct references.
The official 3D-Inspector HTML is not modified to implement these renderer variants.
The selected preset uses normals only for color-view confidence; it is not normal-free.
The approximately ±30-degree useful range is a visual judgment for this subject and orthographic comparison, not a universal angular guarantee.
F/H have different aligned atlas sampling as well as geometry, so the cross-asset comparison does not isolate geometry alone.
result: Front RGB fidelity improves; natural full-body camera rotation remains unmet. No nonzero angle range is certified artifact-free.
